description: Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 USA Cascade development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5. Canonical firmware replaces separate transport, logging, power-saving, and gain variants; use runtime settings. All Full Companions send MOTA; infrastructure has a qualified wireless self-update path. Exact-target bootloader, storage and partition requirements are in each entry. USB web console: https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Feature switches: https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

companionWifi.name: Companion WiFi
companionWifi.description: Companion radio over trusted local Wi-Fi (TCP port 5000). First-time network setup uses the MeshCore setup access point; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

sensor.name: Sensor
sensor.description: Telemetry node that reads and publishes only the sensors compiled for and detected on the selected board; this custom role is not a companion or repeater.

companionEthernet.name: Companion Ethernet
companionEthernet.description: Companion radio over wired Ethernet (TCP port 5000). Requires compatible Ethernet hardware and a DHCP network; this custom role may not map to the standard Configure step.

companionFull.name: Full Companion
companionFull.description: All supported Companion transports and host-backed MOTA sending in one exact-board image. Full starts in ASCII USB mode. WiFi/BLE availability and self-update depend on the board; configure MQTT through WebConfig where included.

standard-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Repeater: Relays mesh traffic to extend coverage.

EXACT TARGET - Ebyte_EoRa-S3_Repeater. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE / LOGGING - ASCII terminal at 115200 baud: https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and ver. set usb.logging on enables live logs; set usb.logging off disables them (no reboot suffix on infrastructure). log start/log stop controls a separate stored RX capture where compiled.

FEATURES - Repeater forwarding uses set repeat on/off separately from logging/MQTT. RXPS uses set radio.rxps on/off. Device power saving uses powersaving on/off or set powersaving on/off with different USB/bridge guards; follow the role guide before enabling sleep. WebConfig uses set webui on/off only when compiled. The USB console does not require WebConfig.

SELF-UPDATE - Qualified wireless methods: wifi. Read the capability manifest for this exact artifact. WiFi uses start ota (or start ota ap), then the returned /update URL; stop ota closes the uploader. On nRF52, start ota invokes Bluetooth DFU. LoRa installation requires an exact destination .mota package; it cannot be flashed as a web-install file.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

CAPACITY - web.webconfig omitted to preserve the legacy portable ESP32 app slot.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/repeater-room-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - Ebyte_EoRa-S3_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. No wireless self-update method was qualified for this artifact. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - GAT562_Mesh_Tracker_Pro_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

MQTT - Use WebConfig broker cards: select/configure a preset and save to enable a slot; select none for every slot and save to disconnect MQTT. Companion does not accept infrastructure bridge.enabled, logging.output, or mqtt.* text commands.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

firmware.subTitle: heltec_rc32_without_display_companion_radio_full — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - heltec_rc32_without_display_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

HARDWARE — Match the display/accessory variant to the hardware actually installed.

firmware.subTitle: heltec_v4_tft_companion_radio_full_femon — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - heltec_v4_tft_companion_radio_full_femon. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

HARDWARE — Match the display/accessory variant to the hardware actually installed.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - heltec_v4_expansionkit_tft_companion_radio_full_femon. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - heltec_v4_r8_tft_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. firmware.subTitle: Heltec_E213_companion_radio_full — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - Heltec_E213_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

firmware.subTitle: Heltec_T190_companion_radio_full_ — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - Heltec_T190_companion_radio_full_. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

firmware.subTitle: heltec_tracker_v2_companion_radio_full_femon — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - heltec_tracker_v2_companion_radio_full_femon. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

firmware.subTitle: ikoka_handheld_nrf_e22_30dbm_096_companion_radio_full — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - ikoka_handheld_nrf_e22_30dbm_096_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. No wireless self-update method was qualified for this artifact. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - T_Beam_S3_Supreme_SX1262_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

ROLE - Repeater: Relays mesh traffic to extend coverage.

EXACT TARGET - LilyGo_T-Echo_Card_repeater_lora_ota_no_external_sensors. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

FEATURES - Repeater forwarding uses set repeat on/off separately from logging/MQTT. RXPS uses set radio.rxps on/off. Device power saving uses powersaving on/off or set powersaving on/off with different USB/bridge guards; follow the role guide before enabling sleep. WebConfig uses set webui on/off only when compiled. The USB console does not require WebConfig.

SELF-UPDATE - Qualified wireless methods: bluetooth. Read the capability manifest for this exact artifact. WiFi uses start ota (or start ota ap), then the returned /update URL; stop ota closes the uploader. On nRF52, start ota invokes Bluetooth DFU. LoRa installation requires an exact destination .mota package; it cannot be flashed as a web-install file.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

CAPACITY - selected optional environmental/ranging drivers omitted; generic I2C and exact-target board peripherals remain unchanged.

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - LilyGo_T-Echo-Lite_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - nibble_screen_connect_companion_radio_full_. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. No wireless self-update method was qualified for this artifact. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - ProMicro_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

firmware.title: Full Companion
firmware.subTitle: RAK_3112_companion_radio_full — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - RAK_3112_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

firmware.title: Full Companion
firmware.subTitle: RAK_3401_companion_radio_full — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - RAK_3401_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

CAPACITY - web.webconfig omitted to preserve the legacy portable ESP32 app slot.

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - Xiao_S3_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

HARDWARE — Match the listed radio module, output stage, and pin map to the exact board; a similarly named radio variant is not a safe substitute.

Board selection note: Use this for a Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 with an external SX1262 wired to DIO1=2, NSS=5, RESET=3, BUSY=4, SCLK/MISO/MOSI=7/8/9, and RXEN=6. Do not use it for the XIAO S3 WIO board, which uses DIO1=39, NSS=41, RESET=42, BUSY=40, and RXEN=38.

If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - Station_G2_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on enables USB logs; set usb.logging off stops them. Logging and binary Companion share one USB port. Turn logging off before handing USB to a Companion app or MOTA host. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: wifi. Full ESP32 WiFi updates use port 8080 only when two application slots are installed. Use the exact board application package.

INSTALL - Full install writes the merged bootloader/partition/application image over USB. Use the app-only Update for compatible in-place updates. OTA does not change partitions: the image must fit the installed slots. A layout migration or explicit erase can lose settings; an ordinary compatible update normally preserves them.

firmware.subTitle: GAT562_Mesh_Watch13_companion_radio_full — USB + supported wireless transports; MOTA sender

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - GAT562_Mesh_Watch13_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.

COMMANDS / BOARD EXCEPTIONS - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/blob/eb4ca56f1ba87bf08741b6c479ed601cccdb1d84/docs/role_feature_switches.md

RELEASE - https://github.com/mikecarper/MeshCore/releases/tag/v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-cascade-dev-26303793

full-companion-v1.17.1.5-halo-keymind-ca.notes:
Keymind Cascade MeshCore v1.17.1.5 development prerelease. USA/Canada 910.525 MHz / BW62.5 / SF7 / CR5; Cascade defaults. Saved settings take precedence.

ROLE - Full Companion: Connects a phone or host to the mesh through the board's supported transports; can send MOTA to other nodes.

EXACT TARGET - WioTrackerL1Eink_companion_radio_full. Match the radio, display, memory and storage hardware before flashing.

USB CONSOLE - Full Companion starts in ASCII mode at 115200 baud. Open https://flasher.meshcore.io/console. Use board and version. If a Companion app has selected binary mode, send +++MESHCORE-TERM-START. Send +++MESHCORE-TERM-STOP and close the terminal before connecting a Companion app or MOTA host.

LOGGING - set usb.logging on reboot enables the second USB logging port; set usb.logging off reboot removes it. Keep Companion/MOTA on the primary USB interface. Fresh installs leave logging off.

POWER SAVING - powersaving on enables device power saving; powersaving off disables it. This is independent of set radio.rxps on/off and WiFi modem sleep. See the role guide for GPS and hardware gain controls.

MOTA SOURCE - Close the USB console and run motatool serve --serial /dev/ttyACM0 --dir ./motas -v on the host. Full Companion serves host-supplied packages to other nodes; it does not LoRa-install them onto itself. Source and destination need overlapping temporary radio windows.

SELF-UPDATE - USB is supported. Qualified optional wireless methods: bluetooth. Use the exact board application package.

BOOTLOADER - nRF52 OTAFIX installations require the exact board/storage profile from OTAFIX 2.4.6: https://github.com/mikecarper/Adafruit_nRF52_Bootloader_OTAFIX/releases/tag/0.11.0-OTAFIX2.4.6. Hybrid internal-flash MOTA receivers require its retained-RAM handoff; QSPI/microSD targets require the matching external-storage bootloader. Full Companion is source-only and keeps its Companion storage layout.

INSTALL - Use the exact board UF2/DFU package or platform-specific USB procedure. An application update does not install a missing OTAFIX bootloader.
